rowText.steps: Switch to another tab and back to Main: fold row still there, closed, same text. Then deck_reloadPlugin, reopen with deck_openPlugin. Same chat reopens, fold row closed with same N; Down from Retry reaches it, A opens to the same text; compare block length and first 80 characters before and after.

reads.note: Before restart: block length 1861 characters, first 80: 'Thinking Process:\n\n1.  **Analyze the Request:** The user asked, "what does the p'.
Switched Ollama tab -> Main tab: fold row still read 'Show reasoning · 16 s', closed (no block).
deck_reloadPlugin: loader restarted and came back ready in 265ms.

deck_openPlugin failed once (CEF debugger ECONNRESET, an expected first-try miss right after a restart), failed a second time with the QAM chord landing over the Recent Games screen instead of opening a pane, then succeeded on the third call.
After reopening: same chat, Main tab, fold row read the same 'Show reasoning · 16 s', closed.
Retry, Down, Down reached the fold row again; A opened it: block length 1861 characters, first 80 chars identical to before the restart.

verdictSentence: After leaving the tab and coming back, and after a full plugin restart, the same chat reopened with the reasoning line reading the same time and opening to the exact same saved text -- length and wording both matched exactly; reopening the plugin panel needed a third try, one more than the brief expected, but that is a known quirk right after a restart, not a reasoning-feature problem.
